description: This PHP source file defines the PaymentMethod class within the Opencart e-commerce platform. The class handles retrieving available payment methods based on the configured extensions and their statuses. It interacts with the system's extension and configuration models to dynamically assemble a list of active payment options.

classes.name: PaymentMethod
classes.description: A class responsible for retrieving available payment methods based on extension configurations within the Opencart platform.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available payment methods by querying enabled payment extensions and their associated methods.
